name: Global Country Atlas
purpose: Parent container for the country layer. The blueprint defines what every country should contain; the source registry defines where values come from; country records contain only normalized observations and provenance; the World Relational Atlas renders and routes those records spatially.
inheritance: country -> countries-blueprint -> field definitions -> source registry -> automated refresh -> normalized country record -> world-map runtime -> spatial/relational view
frontend_rule: Do not expose blueprint instructions as country content. Frontend shows resulting data, freshness, provenance, meaningful comparisons, relationships, issues and research gaps. The frontend is never a second canonical database.
spatial_rule: Sovereign/observer countries use the canonical 195-state index. Territories and subnational regions use distinct typed nodes and must not be silently promoted to sovereign-state records merely because they have map polygons.
map_interaction: click polygon -> resolve ISO3 -> country index -> lazy-load canonical record -> overlay empirical relationships + project interpretation + issue routes + repair questions -> trace outward through typed edges
game_like_boundary: Exploration progress may measure source coverage, resolved relationships, freshness, mechanism quality and repair analysis. Human suffering, trafficking, slavery, civilian harm or other abuse is never converted into game points or collectibles.
epistemic_boundary: Empirical country statistics remain empirical. Political classifications are sourced or explicitly analytical. Symbolic Tree/Axis/angel/demon/karmic material remains project interpretation or project canon and is never presented as measured population data or legal authority.
